public_definitions: Goal: Review the state incidence dashboard, then open the state incidence record that should be routed into the highest-incidence priority follow-up workflow.
Routing criterion: Highest incidence state in the dashboard
Options: Open California (CA) incidence detail for priority follow-up, Open Tennessee (TN) incidence detail for priority follow-up, Open Delaware (DE) incidence detail for routine monitoring
